title: Phone screens fan out from one
summary: One numbered phone screen holds centre, then four more slide out from behind it into a symmetric fan while the group eases back to 91 %. A 1.3 s reveal of several app screens that then holds still as a poster.
use_when: Showing that an app has several screens or steps in one short shot
A silent opener or loop tile for an app launch post
Intro beat before a longer phone feature tour
Placeholder layout to drop real screenshots into, numbered by order

look.type_style: medium grotesk; large two-digit index top-left of each screen (~9 % H on the centre screen), three short stacked lines lower-left (~3 % H), sentence case, white on the screen colour

sfx.event: side screens slide out from behind the centre screen (inner pair f9, outer pair f12)

structure.shot: one numbered blue phone screen centred on flat light grey, then four more fan out behind it, two each side, smaller and lower with depth
structure.camera: pull-out: whole group scale 1.00 -> 0.91 between f9 and ~f40, then static to f90
structure.motion: f0-8 single screen holds; f9 inner pair slides out from behind the centre, outer pair follows at f12 (stagger 3 fr); offsets to +-17 % W and +-30 % W, scales 0.90 and 0.77, settle ~f40 with easings.outQuint ~31 fr, no overshoot; hold f40-90

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the backdrop, accent as the screen fill, display font for index and lines
params.content.screens: 3 or 5 screens (centre first, then pairs outward): screenshot src or {index, lines[]} placeholder
params.content.lines: up to 3 short lines on each placeholder screen, 1 word each
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; fan offsets are fractions of frame width, cap the fan at 80 % W
params.timing.holdFirst: frames the single centre screen holds before the fan (default 9)
params.timing.pairStagger: frames between inner and outer pair (default 3)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips: single screen f0-8, inner pair starts f9, outer pair f12, settled ~f40 (+-3 fr), static f40-90 (motion.json diff 0 in the last second). Final layout at 1322x992: centre screen 24 % W x 70 % H; inner pair centres +-17 % W, scale 0.90, centres 1.3 % H lower; outer pair +-30 % W, scale 0.77, 4 % H lower; all upright, no rotation, z-order centre on top. Side screens come out from behind the centre, not from off-screen as the catalogue hint says, and the hint's overshoot is not visible at 30 fps. Family hint 3d-device rejected: the layering is flat 2D with scale for depth. Soft drop shadow under each screen. Proposed term fan-spread (not in vocabulary). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
